text.tspan: Q49 · How Loki works: index the labels, not the text
pick chunks by labels, then grep the text
Labels: low cardinality (app, namespace, pod, level). request_id as a label = millions of tiny streams.
Loki: high volume, multi-cloud / on-prem, one Grafana. CloudWatch: small, zero-ops, AWS-managed sources.
